workloads.name: plain
workloads.declared: GET /private with no request header of its own, jemalloc preloaded: the record page for one visitor, about 6 KB, not kept. Touched: every wake of the connection's task polls the wait for shutdown on the base and loads one flag on the head. Margin +1%, no floor; no reduction claimed.

workloads.name: unstaged
workloads.declared: GET /unstaged with no request header of its own, jemalloc preloaded: a short text from a route outside the app's stages, the cheapest request the probe has. Touched, as every request is. Margin +1%, no floor; no reduction claimed.

workloads.name: plainglibc
workloads.declared: The request of plain to the same binary started with no preload, so on glibc's allocator. Touched as plain is; read because the one count in the tree that is a rise is glibc's. Margin +1%, no floor; no reduction claimed.
